subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/commands/query-batch.ts

M1_load_per_query._note: R1: run-query --batch has no second memo since the M13 finding; B14 counts loads by spy over TWO runs (first run's misses load per entry), B14c expects graphLoads=1 with two misses.

M2_load_per_query_counter_once._note: graphLoads stays 1 (the code lies about itself); only the independent loader spies see the extra loads — B1/B1c/R1 and B14 (spy over two runs). B14c does not see it: it reads graphLoads, which the mutant pins to 1.

M4_stop_after_first_failure._note: B3, B13 and B13c are red too, legitimately: their FIRST entry fails (refused UPDATE / injected timeout); stopping drops the second entry, so the summary sits where the axis expects the second record.

M5_rc0_on_failure._note: finish() is shared by both verbs: R1/R6 (run-query --batch) and B13c read rc 5 too.

M8_progress_via_console_log._note: B15 reads the cache-write warning from stderr; the mutant sends every progress line to console.log.

M9_write_not_awaited._note: B17 too: the sink's write resolves without waiting for the callback, so it no longer rejects on EPIPE.
